title: 第一千六百九十四章 面包第一千六百九十三章 虚幻的伯伯
slug: 荒村物语第一千六百九十四章面包
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：荒村物语正文第一千六百九十四章　面包？（..la）也不知为何，见了狗爷，少秋的心情可谓是相当复杂，简直可以说五味杂陈，特别是在想起往事的时候，更是如此了。
可是……
可是少秋不予以追究了。觉得事情并非那么简单，此时再去对付，或许不妥，届时恐怕真的会中了某些人的奸计，从而使自己陷入万劫不复之境地也未可知啊。
因此之故，少秋不打算去对付狗爷了。
何况他还有了少女，此时再还要去做什么复仇之事呢？
于是凑上前去，而后准备掏出一支烟来，打算递到狗爷的手上，算是与之和好如初了。可是不成，人狗爷并非待见，此时啐了一口口水，因为看到少秋递过来的并非是烟，而到底是何物，尚且还不得而知，反正极其肮脏，非常恐怖。
那东西在少秋看来，或许是烟，却不知为何，便成了狗爷眼里的一些不太好的东西，因为那东西，放到哪里，它也只能是一条蜥蜴。
这样的东西作为烟递给人家，这恐怕不太好吧，简直可以说欺人太甚啊。甚至可以说是把自己当成了一些连屎都不如的东西了。
“唉，拿着吧。”少秋忙着把那“烟”塞进了狗爷的手里去。
“你自己抽吧。”看着少秋递过来的这样的不成敬意的东西，狗爷当时就脸色大变，不断地啐着口水，知道此人或许是想借这样的机会，给自己放蛊吧，一时之间如何不生气，甚至直接就要那个了。
“好吧。”少秋边无奈地说道，边把那烟递到了花伯的手里去了。
……
花伯接住了那烟，直接就当着少秋的面吸食起来了。
看到花伯吃这样的肮脏不堪的东西，狗爷心情可想而知，却也来得正好，或许如此一来，想必那少秋日后便不会再对付自己了啊。毕竟世上之人，论胆量，还真是没有几个敢生吃这样的东西啊。
见花伯吃这样的不干净的东西，狗爷心情好了些，似乎有了靠山，看以后呀，少秋还敢不敢寻仇，还敢不敢伤害自己！
想到此处，狗爷的脸上露出了淡淡的笑容了。
左右看了看，知道花伯可能是不打算活了，因为把这样的肮脏的东西都吃下肚子里去了，这样的人还有什么事情干不出来呢？肯定是少秋对小花做了什么见不得人的坏事，此时拚了，非要与之来个了断不可。
当然，这也是因为有狗爷在，不然的话，想必花伯是无论如何没有那个胆子的。
怕被人利用的狗爷，这时只好是走开了，不肯再呆在少秋的屋子门前，怕这样下去，白白地帮了人家的忙，恐怕也不太好。
那花伯抽了一阵子烟后，这便也从自己的破败不堪的口袋里掏摸了半天，愣是把自己的裤子都掏破了，甚至还伤着了自己的皮肉，这才掏出来一个物事，吓得狗爷直接就再往外面躲了躲，似乎怕掏摸出来的东西有毒，届时万一溅射那怕一丁点在自己的身上，或许就不好了，谁知道有毒没有呢？

那是一坨漆黑的东西！
那东西狗爷此前看到过，是花伯在路边随便捡来的一坨非常肮脏的狗拉的屎。当时见了这样的狗，狗爷还捂着鼻子呢，似乎怕这样的狗熏着了自己，而他恰巧又有鼻炎来着。
于是只好是敬而远之，万不敢靠近啊。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1694 of the main text of A Deserted Village: Bread? (..la) For some reason, Shaoqiu's mood was quite complicated after meeting Mr. Gou. It could be said that he had mixed feelings, especially when he thought of the past.
But...
But Shaoqiu did not pursue it. I feel that the matter is not that simple. It may not be appropriate to deal with it at this time. I am afraid that I will really fall into the tricks of some people and put myself in a situation that is beyond redemption.
For this reason, Shaoqiu no longer plans to deal with Mr. Gou.
What's more, he has a girl, what else is he going to do for revenge now?
So he stepped forward and took out a cigarette, intending to hand it to Mr. Gou as a way of making peace with him. But it didn't work. The man and the dog were not waiting for him. He spat at this time because he saw that what Shaoqiu handed over was not a cigarette, but what it was was not yet known. Anyway, it was extremely dirty and terrifying.
In Shaoqiu's opinion, that thing might be smoke, but for some reason, it became something not very good in Master Gou's eyes, because no matter where it was placed, it could only be a lizard.
I'm afraid it's not good to hand something like this to someone as a cigarette. It can be said to be too much of a deception. It can even be said that he regards himself as something worse than shit.
"Hey, take it." Shaoqiu hurriedly put the "cigarette" into Master Gou's hand.
"You can smoke it yourself." Seeing such an disrespectful thing handed over by Shaoqiu, Mr. Gou's face changed drastically and he kept spitting. He knew that this person might want to take this opportunity to put a poison on himself. How could he not be angry for a moment, or even ask for it directly.
"Okay." Shaoqiu said helplessly and handed the cigarette to Uncle Hua's hand.
…
Hua Bo caught the cigarette and started smoking it directly in front of Shaoqiu.
Seeing Uncle Hua eating such dirty food, one can imagine Master Gou's mood, but he came at the right time. Perhaps in this way, Shaoqiu would not deal with him again in the future. After all, in terms of courage, there are really not many people in the world who would dare to eat such a thing raw.
Seeing Uncle Hua eating such unclean food, Mr. Gou felt better and seemed to have a backer. Let's see in the future, will Shaoqiu still dare to seek revenge and hurt himself?
Thinking of this, Master Gou showed a faint smile on his face.
Looking around, I knew that Uncle Hua probably didn't want to live anymore, because he had eaten such dirty things. What else could such a person not do? Shaoqiu must have done something shameful and bad to Xiaohua. At this time, he was desperate and had to end it.
Of course, this is also because Master Gou is here, otherwise, Uncle Hua would not have the courage anyway.
Afraid of being taken advantage of, Mr. Gou had no choice but to walk away at this time and refused to stay in front of Shaoqiu's house anymore. He was afraid that it would not be good if he continued like this and helped others in vain.
After the Hua Bo smoked for a while, he dug around in his dilapidated pockets for a long time. He tore his pants and even hurt his flesh. Then he took out something, which scared Mr. Dog and hid outside again. He seemed to be afraid that the thing he took out was poisonous. If even a little bit of it splashed on his body, it might not be good. Who knows if it is poisonous or not?
That's a dark thing!
That thing, Mr. Dog, had seen before. It was a very dirty piece of dog poop that Uncle Hua randomly picked up on the roadside. When he saw such a dog, Mr. Dog was still holding his nose, as if he was afraid that such a dog would inflame him, and he happened to have rhinitis.
So I had to keep a respectful distance and never dare to get close.
